map.输入距离、平均速度与中途休息，计算驾驶时长、休息时长、总耗时及预计到达时间。: Enter distance, average speed and rest stops to compute driving time, rest time, total duration and estimated arrival time.
map.行驶时长(分钟) = 距离(km) ÷ 平均速度(km/h) × 60；休息时长: Driving time (min) = distance (km) ÷ average speed (km/h) × 60; rest time = number of rests × minutes per rest; total duration = driving time + rest time; estimated arrival = departure time + total duration (rolling over past midnight); a total duration over 240 minutes suggests a rest every 2 hours; average speed is best taken as 90 to 110 km/h for highways and 50 to 70 km/h for national roads to stay close to real conditions.
map.道路类型（参考限速，可调整平均速度）: Road type (reference speed limit; you can adjust average speed)
map.国道/快速路（限速 100 km/h，建议均速 ~70）: National road / expressway (limit 100 km/h, suggested average ~70)
map.城市主干道（限速 60 km/h，建议均速 ~35）: Urban arterial road (limit 60 km/h, suggested average ~35)
map.💡 建议：连续驾驶 4 小时应休息不少于 20 分钟。本工具按距离÷平均速度估算: 💡 Recommendation: after 4 hours of continuous driving you should rest for at least 20 minutes. This tool estimates pure driving time as distance ÷ average speed; actual results are affected by road conditions and weather.
map.长途出行前按距离与平均车速估算纯驾驶时间，叠加休息次数得出总耗时与到达时间。: Before a long trip, estimate pure driving time from distance and average speed, then add the rests to get total duration and arrival time.
map.按出发时间推算预计到达时刻，便于安排接站、住宿与中转。: Work out the estimated arrival time from the departure time, which helps arrange pickups, lodging and transfers.
map.用驾驶时长占比判断行程强度，识别疲劳驾驶风险（连续驾驶 4 小时应休息）。: Use the share of driving time to judge trip intensity and identify fatigue driving risk (rest after 4 hours of continuous driving).

Trip intensity: <240 minutes is easy (<4h), 240~480 is moderate (4~8h), >480 is long (>8h); a prompt to schedule rest appears when pure driving time reaches 240 minutes or more.
map.距离 300 km、平均车速 80 km/h：纯驾驶 = 300/80×60 =: Distance 300 km at an average speed of 80 km/h: pure driving = 300/80×60 = 225 minutes (3h45m); 2 rests of 20 minutes = 40 minutes; total duration 265 minutes (4h25m, "moderate"); departing at 08:00 gives an estimated arrival at 12:25, with driving about 85% of the total time.
map.平均车速怎么取才准？: How do I pick an accurate average speed?
map.应低于道路限速，按车型与路况折算：高速可取限速的 0.8~0.9，国道/山路更低: It should be below the road speed limit and converted according to vehicle type and road conditions: for highways take 0.8~0.9 of the limit, lower for national roads and mountain roads. Fold service area, congestion and toll station time into rests or extra margin, which is closer to reality than simply using the speed limit.
map.为什么强调连续驾驶 4 小时？: Why emphasize 4 hours of continuous driving?
map.连续驾驶 4 小时以上未停车休息属于疲劳驾驶，反应能力明显下降；法规也要求长途客: Driving over 4 hours without stopping to rest counts as fatigue driving and reaction time drops markedly; regulations also require long-distance passenger transport to stop and rest as prescribed, so trip planning should reserve rest segments in advance.
